response.text:
I can help — but I can’t watch your inbox or send messages in the background unless you explicitly grant access to an automation/connector or confirm you want me to act now. Options and next steps:

1) If you want automatic monitoring + sending
- I can set up an automation if you connect and authorize your recruiting Gmail (or give whatever mailbox) so I can watch for Amara’s reply and send the countersigned PDF immediately. I’ll need:
  - Permission to access that mailbox and send email on your behalf.
  - The countersigned PDF to attach (upload it here or tell me where it is).
  - The exact trigger rules (e.g., any reply from Amara, reply on the offer thread, subject contains “offer”).
  - The email text you want sent (or confirm a short template I can use).
  - Confirmation that sending automatically is OK.

2) If you don’t want to enable automation
- I can prepare everything now: a ready-to-send email (with attachment) and a 5:00 PM summary message. I’ll either:
  - Give you the draft and attachment so you can send it when Amara replies; or
  - Create a calendar reminder at 5 (if you allow calendar access) to prompt you to send the summary. Note: I won’t be able to automatically watch the inbox or send the message.

Quick clarifying questions so I can proceed:
- Do you want automatic monitoring (and will you authorize mailbox access) or do you prefer drafts/instructions?
- Which email address/label/folder should I watch for Amara’s reply?
- Who exactly should receive the countersigned PDF (Amara only? CC anyone?) and what should the email say? If you want a template, confirm signature line.
- Please upload the countersigned PDF (or tell me where it is).
- Which time zone is “5” and what should the 5:00 summary include (e.g., copy of Amara’s reply, send time, next steps, any other recruiting inbox activity)?

Tell me which option you prefer and answer the quick questions above and I’ll prepare the next step.
